1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c5 4.cxd5 exd5 5.d.strategy: Steps away from the d4 pawn while guarding c5, the extra pawn White is trying to hold. The knight on the rim has few good squares and is easily harassed, so keeping the pawn demands accuracy.

Attacks the knight on a4, which has no comfortable square, and keeps up the pressure on c5, since the bishop on f8 sees it along the open diagonal. Black gains time and plays to recover the pawn while White is still undeveloped.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c5 4.cxd5 exd5 5.d.name: Tarrasch Defence: Tarrasch Gambit
